name: @tundraconnect/open-meteo
description: Typed Open-Meteo weather client for Deno, Bun, Node.js, browsers and Cloudflare Workers: Forecast, Ensemble (every member), Previous Runs, Historical Forecast, Single Runs and archive APIs, with explicit model choice (GFS, HRRR, ECMWF IFS, ICON, ...) and any variable by name.
